title: Adventures in Nodeland
subtitle: I write about my journey as a core contributor of Node.js, an author, and a maintainer of many modules - including [Fastify](https://www.fastify.io) and [Pino](https://www.getpino.io). I will also write about my journey as the Co-Founder & CTO of [Platformatic](https://platformatic.dev). In addition, I speak at conferences and will add links to all my talks in case you missed one. If you like my Open Source work, consider sponsoring me on [GitHub](https://github.com/sponsors/mcollina)
